preconditions.description: The number of words in the dictionary must be between 1 and 8.
The number of letter cells must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 5 for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word in the dictionary must be a non-empty string of no more than 5 lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of different instances of chainwords modulo 998244353.
